acceptance_criteria.claim: Unknown execution state is handled safely
acceptance_criteria.observed_result: Unknown state handling defaults to SAFE_DEFAULT_BLOCK. Duplicate action prevention via attempt_ledger. Duplicate artifact prevention via content-addressable SHA256.
acceptance_criteria.independent_check: Verified: idempotency_test.json shows unknown_state_handling=SAFE_DEFAULT_BLOCK (not auto-success). Tested scenarios include task retry after crash with attempt_ledger preventing re-execution of COMPLETED tasks.

acceptance_criteria.observed_result: Attempt ledger tracks execution state. Content-addressable SHA256 prevents duplicate artifacts. Evidence hash deduplication prevents duplicate evidence records.
acceptance_criteria.independent_check: Verified: interruption_matrix.json scenario A shows NO_DUPLICATE_ACTION after checkpoint restore. idempotency_test.json confirms attempt_ledger_check, CONTENT_ADDRESSABLE_SHA256, EVIDENCE_HASH_DEDUP mechanisms.

acceptance_criteria.observed_result: Human gate created at gate_id=decision-6e3857a1, checkpoint_id=checkpoint-e3f3f443aa70, human_gate_preserved=true. Decision processed after restore.
acceptance_criteria.independent_check: Verified: interruption_matrix.json scenario E explicitly tests human gate during checkpoint restore with result HUMAN_GATE_PRESERVED. human_gate_resume.json shows gate preserved and decision led to state transition WAITING_HUMAN->RUNNING.
